newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Sharon to visit Russia on gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Sharon to visit Russia on gas deal.

text.p: Israel's National Infrastructure Minister Ariel Sharon will visit Russia at the end of this month to discuss the possible purchase of natural gas, the minister's spokesman said on Sunday.
The invitation to Sharon was a result of a recent trip to Russia by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Sharon has not yet finalised the date for his own official visit to Moscow.
Any natural gas brought from Russia would have to travel via pipeline to Turkey and then by an undersea pipeline to Israel.

The Maariv daily said such a project would require an investment of over $2 billion. But Sharon's spokesman said it was too early to make such an estimate since the amount of natural gas that could be purchased was not yet known.
